stalls.summaryZh: 藏在夜市巷弄的百年家族老店，麻醬麵拌菜脯、現炸餛飩都是點名率高的品項；店小常客滿，在地人愛去。
stalls.summaryEn: A century-old family shop tucked in an alley of the market; sesame noodles with dried radish and fried wontons are the usual picks. Small and often full, popular with locals.

stalls.summaryEn: A century-old name that hand-kneads its aiyu jelly fresh daily. Visitors find it lightly sweet and refreshing, a good break while walking the market.

stalls.summaryZh: 創立於1949年的冰品老店，番茄切盤沾薑汁醬油是特色；雪花冰綿密、份量大，兩人分剛好，店內座位寬敞。
stalls.summaryEn: An ice shop dating to 1949, known for tomato slices with ginger-soy dip. Its snow ice is fine-textured and large enough to share; seating is roomy.

stalls.summaryEn: Pingtung-style steamed ba-wan kept warm in braising sauce, with a soft, chewy skin and garlic-cilantro topping. Open only from early morning to noon, so night visitors will miss it.

stalls.summaryEn: A long-running southern-style zongzi shop with generous fillings including salted egg yolk, sold in three sizes. Open late, served with miso soup.
